description: This is a React component file that manages the Users page in a dashboard application. It includes functionality for listing users, creating new users, editing existing users, deleting users, and handling UI states such as loading, errors, and toast notifications. The file imports several UI components and API endpoints, and defines internal hooks and state management to facilitate user management features.

methods.name: useToast()
methods.description: Custom hook providing toast notification functionality with auto-dismiss feature.

methods.name: fetchUsers
methods.description: Fetches user list from backend API, updates state and handles errors.

methods.name: submitCreate(e)
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new user with optimistic UI update and error handling.

methods.name: submitEdit(e)
methods.description: Handles editing of existing user data with optimistic update and error handling.

methods.name: confirmDelete()
methods.description: Confirms and executes user deletion, with optimistic UI update and error handling.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the user form state to default values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form input fields before submit.
